selection_rule: from the 7811 official-train clips that carry at least one action segment, pick 1400 with an even stride over the lexicographically sorted video ids (idx_i=floor(i*N/n)); split into 70/15/15 by contiguous blocks of that sorted selection (Charades ids are random 5-char strings so id order is effectively random; the split unit is the video id)
class_rule: the 50 most frequent action classes among the selected clips, each with >= 60 annotated segments
